scope: Leica M9 production JPEG interpolation dispatch/order
proof_chain: RBCLOSURE5AC: BF547 Leica diagnostic table identifies ImageSettings+4 modes as 0=Raw, 1=RawTotal, 2=Dng, 3=Jpg.
RBCLOSURE5U: SPI settings payload byte 4 is copied verbatim into queue record/ImageSettings+4; no BF561 transform changes this selector.
RBCLOSURE5Q: source mode 3 maps through SetStructParameter/Set to g_L2Parameter word0=0x17FF, with Run bits 4 and 5 both set. Source mode 2 maps to 0x3407, with bits 4 and 5 both clear.

RBCLOSURE5I: Run bit4 dispatches GreenInterpolationWithCo and resumes before the later bit5 test; bit5 dispatches ASMRedBlueInterpolation1. With both bits set, Green executes first and R/B second in the same Run invocation.

Dng_2.meaning: raw/DNG output bypasses these JPEG interpolation stages

production_conclusion: A normal Leica M9 JPEG is processed on mode 3 (Jpg). That mode enables both interpolation stages. The firmware CFG proves Green interpolation runs before Red/Blue interpolation in the same Run invocation. This is no longer a hypothesis or address-order inference.
superseded_false_lead: BF547 0x471c4 is not treated as a SportNet command-7 sender. Its R2=7 is consumed as a 0..13 generic serializer/type selector by 0x6c3dc.
implementation_policy: Do not change production renderer solely from this ordering closure. First perform a port-readiness audit of exact GreenInterpolationWithCo and ASMRedBlueInterpolation1 arithmetic, geometry, edge behavior, packed-phase handling, rounding/clamping, and current-renderer delta.
